scenario_root_cause.statement: Scenario-defined expected cause: source-system technical outage affecting Unified Inbox data retrieval. The operational record must be checked against its timestamps; this is not proof of a current outage.

troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Confirm that PM7 is the affected source system and record when the slow load occurred, including timezone.
troubleshooting_steps.expected_observation: The source system and observation time are recorded.
troubleshooting_steps.handling_when_unclear: Ask the reporter for an approximate timestamp and timezone.

troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Check operational incident OPS-PM7-09 and compare its status and time window with the reported delay.
troubleshooting_steps.expected_observation: The incident record supplies a status as of a timestamp, a scheduled window, and any actual resolution time.
troubleshooting_steps.handling_when_unclear: Treat a stale or missing status as unconfirmed; check the operational incident owner/process.

troubleshooting_steps.instruction: If a matching incident is currently active, retry after its confirmed recovery; if the delay persists outside the incident window, collect a fresh timestamp and escalate through the source-system support process.
troubleshooting_steps.expected_observation: The retry is made after confirmed recovery, or a new report is linked to an active incident.
troubleshooting_steps.handling_when_unclear: Do not treat a planned end time as confirmed recovery.
